gloss: look in one's eyes; gaze; expression of the eyes

definitions.gloss: look in one's eyes; gaze; the way someone's eyes appear
definitions.explanation: Refers to the quality or impression conveyed by someone's eyes — whether kind, sharp, suspicious, or angry. Often used to describe how a person's eyes make others feel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧{目|め}つき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧。
examples.english: A man with a sharp gaze.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{優|やさ}しい{目|め}つき⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: She looked at the child with gentle eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目|め}つき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怖|こわ}くて→怖い：00864_kowai⟧、⟦{話|はな}しかけられなかった→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧。
examples.english: That person's gaze was so scary that I couldn't bring myself to talk to them.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye) + つき (manner, way of appearing). Describes the overall impression created by someone's eyes. Often carries a subjective nuance — the same person's eyes may be described differently depending on the observer's impression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧{目|め}つき: a sharp, piercing gaze
- {優|やさ}しい{目|め}つき: a gentle look in the eyes
- ⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧{目|め}つき: a scary/intimidating look
- {目|め}つき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to have a menacing look in one's eyes
- {目|め}つき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: one's expression changes (in the eyes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {眼差|まなざ}し: gaze — more literary and often implies emotional depth or warmth
- ⟦{視線|しせん}→視線：14138_shisen⟧: line of sight — more neutral; focuses on where someone is looking, not the quality of the eyes
- ⟦{顔|かお}つき→顔つき：19660_kaotsuki⟧: facial expression — the broader equivalent covering the whole face
